title.rendered: Summer Office Hours + Other School Info

content.rendered:
Our school office will be closed for summer break June 24th – August 9th. Our office will re-open on Monday, August 12th and our office hours will be Monday-Friday 7:30 am – 3:30 pm.

During the summer break if you need assistance with anything please call our district office at 503-825-5000. Or you can visit their office at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd. Monday – Thursday, 7:30-4:00.

If you would like to resgister a new incoming student please follow this LINK for our online registration information. You may also contact the district office at 503-825-5000 for assistance with this process.

You can find our school supply lists for the 24-25 school year here: Middleton Supply List for 24-25 School Year / Lista de Utiles Escolares – Espanol.

If you have a new incoming kindergartener you could read more about the start of the year in the this SSD Kindergarten Newsletter because their start is a little differently that our other grades.
